title: 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus", at revision 1382150879, opens: "The 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus, also known as the 1860 Christian–Druze war, was a civil conflict in Mount Lebanon during Ottoman rule in 1860–1861 fought mainly between the local Druze and Christians." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3772246, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "civil conflict within the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
